tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
Web3 content is all over the place at the moment but the amount of people focusing their time and effort trying to figure it out and level up has never been so high. 

2023 will be quite a year for media in this space, very excited for what's next from us and everybody else.

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text: Every Spaces I listen into, people are trying to figure it out or at least are talking about ways to make it work. Right now, the tools are limited. We have to use Web2 platforms, but they are not giving us what we need or want just yet. It'll happen, slowly but surely.

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text: One example is Twitter. At the moment, Spaces is almost unusable, it's impossible for the participant/consumer to find new content and even consuming on the app feels like a lot. I have a feeling this will drastically change under @ElonMusk, very excited to see where he takes it.

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text: Whether your numbers are up or down, you just need to keep going and keep elevating your production value. You need to focus your time and effort on delivering better content and levelling up every day. At one point, it will hit.

tweets.text:
Few clarifications on the @CoryVanLew x @RugRadio PFP mint ( 🧵):

1. Official mint date is Monday, February 6th. There will be a 48 hour mint window for:

- Rug Radio Genesis NFT holders: 1 NFT = 1 PFP for 690 $RUG
- Cory Van Lew 1 of 1 holders: 1 NFT = 5 PFPs for FREE

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
Unless you hear it FROM ME that the mint is open, DO NOT MINT ANYTHING. You will literally hear it from MY voice and I will go live on video a well.

3. We want to allow more communities to mint the PFP and thus enter the Rug Radio ecosystem, so here is the deal with "wave 2":

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
- Rug Radio $RDAO holders: We took a snapshot on December 27th. If you held 1 $RDAO before that day, you get 1 FREE PFP. 

2. As above mentioned, the first "wave" is open for 48 hours. You will know where to mint when I personally come on Twitter Spaces AND video to announce it.

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text: - We will announce wave 2 as soon as wave 1 ends. The Rug Radio team, Cory, and myself, will make a decision at that moment, and we will most probably go into wave 2 the next day, to leave us time to allow list different communities.

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
- We are waiting for the first wave to determine how many PFPs we will be selling immediately after.

- The hard cap is 20,000, since we have 20k Genesis Rug Radio NFTs. That does not mean there will be 20k PFPs, it means it's our maximum.

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
I want to make it super clear: at the moment, the *only* way to guarantee a PFP mint is by qualifying for wave 1, and the details are in the first and second tweets of this thread.

If you're a Genesis NFT holder, you can claim your $RUG on our website: https://rug.fm

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text: - Wave 3, if go that far, will be a mint in ETH as well. This is something we wanted to open to the public, with a limit of 1 PFP per wallet. The thought was to allow people who didn't win any raffles or premints to be able to get a PFP as well. More details to follow.

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
- Wave 2 will be a mint in ETH, with the mint price to be announced at the same time we announce the final supply for our PFPs, and the communities we have allow listed.

More details to follow on the allow listing, but I can't wait to involve more communities!!!

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
If you have any additional questions and want to play it safe, you can join our Discord server where our moderators and community members will be more than happy to help you! 

👉

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
Louis Vuitton, one of the worlds oldest and most important fashion brands founded in 1854, has now entered the NFT space.

This is a monumental event in the history of luxury and fashion, as the Maison looks towards crypto and the future of digital collectibles.

(1/16) 🧵👇

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
To understand the importance of this release, one needs to know the history behind the @LouisVuitton trunks and why they are so meaningful. Having been selected as a VIA Guide by the Maison, I was lucky enough to be invited to Asnières, aka the heart of Louis Vuitton.

(2/16)

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
Louis Vuitton outgrew his HQ in Paris, and relocated right outside the capital in 1859. The house you see in the photos/videos in the tweets was not only the family home, but also where the trunkmaking operations were moved to, and where they still are 164 years later!

(3/16)

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
Louis Vuitton started as a Malletier (trunk maker), known to be of such high quality that a few were found in the remains of the Titanic with items inside left in good shape! Today, the trunks are some of the most sought after items in luxury. 

(4/16)

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
So why am I talking history here? Well, that's because out of all things Louis Vuitton could have released, they created their first ever digitally collectible trunk tied to the physical item, but it is also a bespoke item with a unique canvas they have never used before.

(5/16)

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
The price point? €39,000, limited to a few hundred pieces. Though this may come as a shock to web3 natives, it is in line with the Maison's history of selling luxury goods, but it doesn't stop there...

(6/16)

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
The VIA "Treasure Trunk" is a Soulbound Token that will unlock exclusive experiences for its holders including unseen collectibles, and a first release with the one and only @Pharrell, the Maison's latest menswear creative director.

(7/16)

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
The limited nature and the historical significance of this release are what makes the Treasure Trunks truly special, and that's why I wanted to explain this to you as a VIA Guide. 

As a collector and an active participant in the NFT space, I also have some thoughts...

(8/18)

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
In the current regulatory climate, seeing one of the most iconic brands in the world embrace cryptocurrency is a massive win for us. 

As pictured below, the Maison is not holding back, and doing this on their main website.

http://on.louisvuitton.com/6005OaALD

(9/16)

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
I have no additional information on whether or not this will be something Louis Vuitton will expand to other items, but the door is clearly open, and we, as an industry, have gotten our foot through it, which is what matters most. 

(10/16)

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
As per NFTs/Digital Collectibles, how many times has our industry been declared dead in the past few years?

I reiterate, ONE OF THE MOST KNOWN BRANDS IN THE WORLD IS LAUNCHING AN NFT.

I could not believe it when I got the call from Louis Vuitton.

(11/16)

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
All in all, I believe this is an event that should be celebrated across the space. Buyer or not, we, as a small but growing industry, are slowly but surely running towards the path of mass adoption and this is an important step.

(12/16)

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
Remember, Louis Vuitton starts, the rest follow. 

The success of this release will not make or break the NFT/Crypto/Digital Collectible industry, but it will open the doors to more market participants, and most importantly, to more use cases, credibility, and adoption.

(13/16)

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
If you made it this far, I appreciate you reading this.

Growing up, I could hardly afford a card holder, and I have worked very hard to get to where I am today. Working alongside @LouisVuitton is an honour and something I don't take for granted.

(14/16)

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
Learning about the history, seeing the Louis Vuitton HQ where all Web3/AI and other endeavours are being built, and finally seeing the historical home of Asnières is something I will cherish my entire life.

(15/16)

tweets.author: farokh
tweets.text:
I want to thank the Louis Vuitton team for selecting me and for gifting me the Treasure Trunk, which I will be minting into my vault and cherishing for decades to come, as I hope to participate in the releases and opportunities it opens up to me!

The end!
